text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With summer training camp just around the 
corner, Narita Top Road and Admire Vega 
went hiking together to build up their 
stamina.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Walking down a path carved out of nature, 
Admire Vega sees herself in it. Realizing 
that there was a path for her, too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taking that to heart, Narita Top Road 
began to ponder. Once she reached the 
summit, what should she aim for next...?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"For now, the Trainer sets their sights on 
settling things with T.M. Opera O. Narita 
Top Road aims for even greater heights 
during this summer training camp."
